answers.ask: Should the whole map read as bright and cartoony, or should the fantasy zone be high-fantasy against realistic biomes?
answers.answer: 전체 맵은 밝고 귀여운 카툰 스타일로 만들어 주세요. 판타지 구역도 같은 스타일 안에서 신비롭게 표현하면 됩니다.

answers.ask: Is the fantasy world reached from the same map, or is it a separate place you travel to?
answers.answer: 판타지 세계는 같은 맵 안에서 이동할 수 있는 별도의 판타지 구역으로 해주세요. 그곳에 환상나무를 배치합니다.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: Should the whole map read as bright and cartoony, or should the fantasy zone be high-fantasy against realistic biomes? A: 전체 맵은 밝고 귀여운 카툰 스타일로 만들어 주세요. 판타지 구역도 같은 스타일 안에서 신비롭게 표현하면 됩니다.
- [author] shape — Q: Is the fantasy world reached from the same map, or is it a separate place you travel to? A: 판타지 세계는 같은 맵 안에서 이동할 수 있는 별도의 판타지 구역으로 해주세요. 그곳에 환상나무를 배치합니다.
- [agent_inferred] scale — Q: How large should the five-zone world be in one isometric frame? A: Use a compact medium map so garden insects and individual pet habitats remain visible.

## Enriched image prompt
Build one bright, cute cartoon pet-collecting world divided into five connected zones: Fantasy, Jungle, Garden, Meadow, and Sea. Put a mystical fantasy tree at the centre of the Fantasy zone, with three fantasy-fruit spawn spots beneath it. Habitat ground there supports dragons, unicorns, phoenixes, nine-tailed foxes, hydras, griffins, wyverns, and white tigers. Distribute hamsters, foxes, wolves, pandas, giraffes, cats, rhinoceroses, parrots, reindeer, and gorillas across suitable Meadow and Jungle habitat patches; include lizards, iguanas, chameleons, and flamingos in the Jungle. The Garden contains dragonflies, stag beetles, grasshoppers, katydids, longhorn beetles, ants, and stick insects. The Sea supports dolphins, orcas, seals, sharks, rays, jellyfish, and sea turtles in visible shallow and open-water habitat areas. Connect all five zones with a simple trail and place one open food stall at their meeting point, visibly selling apples and feed fish.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim because the experience centres on befriending animals as pets. Adventure is secondary for exploring five habitat zones and finding fantasy fruit.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-open`, taken from outside Roleplay & Avatar Sim's usual set, because all five habitat zones coexist in one contiguous map. The preset is none because Pet Care's claimable housing and Animal Sim's den-and-social bundle are not requested.

## Config requirements
Use universal `npc-population` for all named fantasy animals, ordinary animals, marine creatures, jungle animals, and garden insects in their stated habitats. Use `water-body` for the Sea zone and its shallow-to-open-water habitat. Use `landmark-focal` for the mystical fantasy tree. Use `path-trail`, taken from Adventure's catalogue row, for the route connecting all five zones. Use `social-hub` for the open apple-and-feed-fish stall at the zone junction. Draw the visible half of `collectible-nodes` as exactly three fantasy fruits beneath the tree.

## Layout requirements
Place `npc-population` occupancy by species across the Fantasy, Jungle, Garden, Meadow, and Sea habitats. Place three `collectible-nodes` Collectibles beneath the fantasy tree, refreshed by mechanics every two minutes. Place one free-text TriggerZone at the food stall. Apple, fish, and fantasy-fruit costs and pet-befriending requirements remain mechanics.

## Layout components
The map contains exactly five connected zones, one central trail junction, one food stall, one fantasy tree, three fantasy-fruit nodes, land habitat patches, one detailed insect garden, and one Sea habitat. Keep each zone visually distinct but within the same cute cartoon style. Compose the map so all five zones and the fantasy tree are visible, with the Garden close enough for its small insects to remain legible.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: the five-biome cartoon composition and mystical tree lead, while the simple connecting trail does not require procedural topology.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is medium because small insects, fruit nodes, shop goods, and individual animal habitats must remain readable despite five zones. The theme is bright, cute cartoon nature with a more mystical version of the same style in the Fantasy zone. The pipeline requires `CHECK` for the Sea as a real swimming volume; the water remains one shallow-to-open surface without self-occluding layers.
